data_quality_assurance: Set up of scientific and technical committee
Use of tools for automatic checks
Consistency verified with data models and standards

format: Given the wide range of experimental and theoretical methods employed within TwistedNano, several data formats will be employed: .pdf, .dat, .txt, .opj, .cif, .cpp, .f90, .vtu, .mph, .cdb, .dxf, .h5p, .eps, .png, .mp3, .mp4. Because additional formats may arise during the implementation, this list will be updated accordingly.

distribution.available_until: We do not foresee any reasons why TwistedNano’s data, once made available, should be withdrawn. In turn, the data and the associated metadata will remain available and findable for the entire lifetime of the repositories.
